Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১) If simple interest on a certain sum of money is Tk. 400 and the rate of interest per annum equals the number of years, then the rate of interest is-
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: If simple interest on a certain sum of money is Tk. 400 and the rate of interest per annum equals the number of years, then the rate of interest is-

Solution:
Let,
The rate of interest is x%
∴ Number of years is x

The interest of 1 year of 100 taka is x
∴ The interest of x years of 100 Taka is x × x = x2

ATQ,
x2 = 400 
∴ x = 20

∴ The rate of interest is 20%

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ২) There is 60% increase in an amount in 6 years at simple interest. What will be the compound interest of Tk. 12,000 after 3 years at the same rate?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: There is 60% increase in an amount in 6 years at simple interest. What will be the compound interest of Tk. 12,000 after 3 years at the same rate?

Solution: 
Let,P = Tk.100
Then, I = Tk. 60
and, T = 6years
we know,
I = Pnr/100
r = (I × 100)/Pn
= (60 × 100)/ (100 × 6)
= 10%

the compound principle of Tk. 12,000 after 3 years at the same rate wii be
C = P(1 + r)n
= 12000 ( 1 + 10/100)3
= 12000 ( 11/10)3
= 12000 (1331/1000)
= 12 × 1331
= 15972
∴ compound interest will be = (15972 - 12000)
= 3972 Tk.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৩) In what time will the simple interest on 1200 Tk. at 4% per annum be the same as that on 600 Tk. at 8% per annum in 2 years?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: In what time will the simple interest on 1200 Tk. at 4% per annum be the same as that on 600 Tk. at 8% per annum in 2 years?

Solution: 
the interest of 600 Tk. at 8% per annum in 2 years is = 600 × 2 × 8%
= 96 Tk.

let, the time is n years.
I = 96 Tk.
P = 1200 Tk.
r = 4%

as we know,
I = Pnr
n = I / Pr
= 96 / (1200 × 4%)
= 2 years

Solution: 
Let the time is = n
C = 15000 + 3150 
= 18150 Tk.
r = 10%

we know,
 C = P(1 + r)n
⇒18150 = 15000(1 + 1/10)n

time, n = 12 years

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৬) What is the difference between the simple interest and the compound interest at 9% per annum for 2 years on a principal of Tk 7000?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: What is the difference between the simple interest and the compound interest at 9% per annum for 2 years on a principal of Tk 7000?

Solution:
We know, Simple Interest, I = Pnr
and Compound Principal, C = p(1 + r)n

Simple Interest = 7000 × 2 × (9/100) = 1260 Tk

Compound Principal = 7000 × {1 + (9/100)}2
= 7000 × (109/100)2
= (7000 × 109 × 109)/(100 × 100)
= 8316.7 Tk.

So, Compound interest = 8316.7 - 7000 = 1316.7 Tk

So, difference = 1316.7 - 1260 = 56.7 Tk

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৮) On a sum of money, the simple interest for 2 years is Tk. 880, while the compound interest is Tk. 928.4, the rate of interest being the same in both cases. The rate of interest is -

Solution:
Difference of Compound interest and Simple interest for 2 years = Tk. (928.4 - 880) = Tk. 48.4
Simple interest for 1 years = 880/2 = Tk. 440

Simple interest on 440 for 1 year = 48.4
Interst rate = {(48.4 × 100)/440}% = 11%

so , the principle amount is = 1500 - 300 = 1200 Tk.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১০) What will be the compound interest of Tk. 3500 in 2 years at 20% per annum if the interest is compounded half - yearly?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: What will be the compound interest of Tk. 3500 in 2 years at 20% per annum if the interest is compounded half - yearly?

Solution: 
P =3500
r = 20% = 10% half - yearly
n = 2 years = 4 half - yearly

we know,
C = P(1 + r)n
= 3500 ( 1 + 10/100)4
= 3500 (11/10)4
= 5124.35
∴ compound interest = 5124.35 - 3500 = 1624.35 Tk.

n = 2 years 
r = 15%

C = p(1 + r)n
= 50000(1 + 15/100)2
= 50000 ( 115/100)2
= 66125

return = 66125 - 50000 = 16125Tk

Solution: 
let, his saray in 2022 was 100 Tk.
at 15% increment,
salary of 2023 is = 100(1 + 15/100)
= 115 Tk.
salary of 2024 is = 115(1 + 15/100)

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৫) A sum of money invested at simple interest becomes 23/10 of itself in 2 years and 6 months. What is the rate of interest per annum?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
Question: A sum of money invested at simple interest becomes 23/10 of itself in 2 years and 6 months. What is the rate of interest per annum?

Solution: 
let,
principle = P
interest, I = (23P/10 - P)
= 13P/10
time, n =  2 years 6 months
= 2.5 years
we know,
I = Pnr/100
r = (100 × I)/Pn
= (100 × 13P/10) /P × 2.5
= 52%
